_comment: GitHub treats a job skipped by its own job-level condition as a SUCCESSFUL required check. Requiring the check name therefore does not protect the workflow that emits it: a PR adding 'if: false' to the job merges green. This push-boundary rule rejects every ordinary Git update touching the workflow path, covering modification, deletion, renaming, path filtering and conditional skipping before any PR can become mergeable. Minimum verified plan: GitHub Team on an organization-owned repository. Install with bin/harness-protect.sh; committing this file does not by itself activate anything.
name: required-quality-workflow-integrity
